title: I Walked Out to Meet It
summary: Tomas takes his little sister’s place on a winter walk to meet a masked creature, then hears someone calling from behind him in a voice he knows.
frame_0: The Well Guest’s blank white mask fills the winter sky. One long black hand reaches over blond Tomas’s shoulder. His startled face is visible beneath the hand, with “I WALKED OUT / TO MEET IT” above them.
package_differences: The camera carries the viewer through the timed framings in one take. Memories of Dad, the door bolt and the real sister appear inside that moving picture.

The original story mix runs to 151.7 seconds. The updated five-second Flashloop phone ending uses two new pictures of Tomas and the Well Guest, with the channel handle and sponsor card in the upper corners.
